title: NoSQL & MongoDB
intro: MongoDB interview questions cover the document data model in interview depth — schema design (embedded vs referenced), indexes (compound, multikey, text, geo), the aggregation pipeline, sharding and zone sharding, replica sets and read concerns, consistency trade-offs (eventual, causal, linearizable reads), and integration with Spring Data MongoDB. Expect senior interviews to compare MongoDB to a relational store and probe on operational concerns (rebalancing, backup, election).
